name: Salve of Mental Pattern
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
This vial contains a dark, silvery-gray salve. When you apply this salve to a willing creature, it congeals into an intricate mesh of lacy fractals that covers the target's body, granting the target resistance 10 to mental damage for 10 minutes, after which the mesh flakes off into powdery crumbs.

Effect: Salve of Mental Pattern
